svg.title: MarkeTech backend: the architecture
svg.desc: General view of the Django backend of MarkeTech, in three panels. Panel A, the layers of backend/: Daphne calls config/asgi.py for each connection; its ProtocolTypeRouter sends HTTP to Django and a WebSocket, after an origin check and the session user, to the live application. Django reads one settings module, config/settings/base.py extended by dev.py or prod.py, named by DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE; base.py holds REST_FRAMEWORK, the defaults of every DRF view: SessionAuthentication, IsAuthenticated and two write throttles, 60 an hour for a demo account and 300 for any other. An HTTP request passes the 11 middleware classes, then config/urls.py: admin/, api/health/, _allauth/ to allauth headless (/_allauth/browser/v1/) and api/ to the urls.py of 8 apps. The 11 apps are grouped by role: people (accounts, profiles), job market (offers, applications, favorites), conversation (messaging, appointments) and platform (reviews, demo), each with models, serializers, views, urls, admin and tests.py unless stated; then two cross-cutting apps without model that the views call after a write: notifications (the e-mails, send.py and moderation.py) and live (the WebSocket /ws/, LiveConsumer, notify.py). templates/ holds the e-mails in English and French, the moderation alerts in French; locale/fr/ the French translations. Imports go one way: urls, views, serializers, models. Panel B, data and outside services: the browser reaches the backend container (Daphne, port 8000) through the reverse proxy and the frontend Nginx in production, the Vite proxy in development; the backend uses the database (SQLite: a file in development, in memory for the tests in CI; PostgreSQL in production), the media volume whose files are served by Django under /api/files/, the channel layer (in memory in development, Redis in production), WhiteNoise for the static files of the admin site and an SMTP server outside the repository in production. Panel C, run, test, build: python manage.py runserver (Daphne's, ASGI) with config.settings.dev, python manage.py test (162 tests in 11 tests.py), the migration and translation commands, and the backend image, python:3.13-slim run by the user app, whose entrypoint.sh migrates, collects the static files, creates the administrator if missing and starts Daphne on port 8000. Reference blocks point to backend-request-flow.svg, backend-data-model.svg, realtime-signal-flow.svg, infra-compose-stack.svg and infra-deployment-pipeline.svg.
svg.text: The whole backend at a glance: its layers, the data and services it uses, and how it is run, tested and
built. Details live in the other diagrams of this folder (grey blocks). Follow the numbers 1 to 15.
Real files of the repository: backend/config/, the 11 apps, templates/, locale/, Dockerfile, entrypoint.sh.

g.text: the data and the outside services: panel B
urls.py -> views -> serializers -> models. After a write, a view calls notifications and live; neither imports a view.
Apps reuse each other's models and helpers (applications imports the permissions of offers), never a view of a later layer.
